newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices ease amid weak activity.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices ease amid weak activity.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures prices fell slightly in overnight Monday trade, with activity drying up after a sharp drop in NYMEX crude prices spooked players, trade sources said.
"A lot of the (speculators) were long going into today...thinking it was time for a rebound," one broker said.
He said locals and major oil companies stepped out of the overnight market to assess where the market would go next.
April NYMEX crude was flat at $20.71 a barrel by 2110 PST. About 724 lots changed hands overall with 526 trading in the front month.
March heating oil, which expires February 28, edged down a mere 0.02 cents a gallon to 55.45 cents, with 188 lots traded and 328 exchanged overall.
March gasoline futures eased 0.04 cents a gallon to 60.20 with 22 lots exchanged in the front month contract and 46 traded in all months.
